purpose: functional verification of machine runs kept across a node restart on KVM; no timing claim

cases.name: a run that had ended is there after the restart, as it ended
a run going when the node was killed is lost, saying so, with its output

detail.reason: the node stopped while it ran

cases.name: a run that printed more than is kept comes back with the same offsets
a new run after the restart takes the next ID, and works
deleting the machine deletes its runs, on disk too
